notes: The size chip in the video header keeps its own shape now. The header rule that sizes the round close button was sizing the chip too, so a label like 1080p spilled out of its pill and into the close button; the chip fits its label, and its chevron turns over while the list is open.
The landscape header keeps the size chip and the close button at the top right of the wide picture, where they were meant to be, instead of sliding to the left when the title hides.
The paired soundtrack of a high size is kept in the page with a one-pixel box rather than hidden from the layout, because a media element with no box at all is one some phones will not play.
